title: $660.8 Million Restitution Request. 13 Days Later, a Pardon.

lines.say: Six hundred sixty point eight million dollars. That is the restitution prosecutors asked Nikola founder Trevor Milton to pay shareholders, on March fourteenth, twenty twenty-five.
lines.show: $660.8 million. That is the restitution prosecutors asked Nikola founder Trevor Milton to pay shareholders, on March 14, 2025.

scene.src: Gov't restitution letter, U.S. v. Milton (Mar 14, 2025)

lines.say: A jury had convicted him of fraud. A judge had given him four years. He was free on bail, appealing.
Thirteen days later came a full and unconditional pardon, covering any fines, forfeitures and restitution ordered by the court.
lines.show: 13 days later came "A Full and Unconditional Pardon," with "remission of any and all fines, penalties, forfeitures, and restitution ordered by the court."

scene.src: Executive Grant of Clemency (Mar 2025), U.S. v. Milton

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
